responses.question: Which surfaces must turn blue: all green accents app-wide (tokens plus hard-coded greens), only the theme tokens, or a single named element?
responses.answer: All green accents app-wide: the :host tokens --green, --green-dark, --mint and every hard-coded green hex value in src/app/app.component.css (gradients, status dot, hover borders, shadows, icon accents).

responses.question: Which blue palette replaces the greens (current --green:#087b66, --green-dark:#075f52, --mint:#e6f4ef)?
responses.answer: Use a standard blue palette: primary #0b5cad, dark #084a8a, tint #e6eef7. Remaining hard-coded greens map to the nearest of these three roles.

responses.question: Should non-green colors stay unchanged (neutral ink #17252d, warning banner ambers, page backgrounds #f7f9f8)?
responses.answer: Yes. Non-green colors remain unchanged; only green-family values are recolored.

responses.question: Is a measurable contrast requirement in scope?
responses.answer: Yes. WCAG 2.1 AA is required: at least 4.5:1 contrast for text on blue surfaces and at least 3:1 for UI component borders and boundaries.

responses.question: The pinned acceptance criteria is only 'screen shot'. What screenshot evidence proves done?
responses.answer: One screenshot of the main chat screen captured after running npm run dev, showing the blue theme applied.
